document_metadata.document_title: Stormwater Manual: A Guide to Stormwater Requirements for Land Disturbing Activities in Arlington County

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Water quality technical criteria aligned with VADEQ Stormwater Management Handbook / Virginia Runoff Reduction Method (VRRM) and Virginia BMP Clearinghouse. County clarifications for BMPs, underdrains, setbacks, waterproofing, and soil/infiltration testing. Energy-balance detention used for water quantity / flood control where applicable.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Energy balance detention / water quantity worksheet
Virginia Stormwater BMP Clearinghouse design specs
approved_bmp_categories: Sheetflow to vegetated filter strip / conserved open space

evidence.excerpt: LAND DISTURBING ACTIVITIES IN ARLINGTON COUNTY
STORMWATER MANUAL: A GUIDE TO STORMWATER REQUIREMENTS
Updated for consistency with new VADEQ Stormwater
energy balance detention for flood control
provided they are designed to drawdown within 24 hours
evidence.page_or_section: 2.9 Requirements for Single Family Residences Built Separately, page 38

evidence.excerpt: Obtain Level I permeable pavement credit for pavement designs with the twelve (12) inches of stone storage and no underdrain
in soils that do not percolate at a rate >0.5 inch hour
Obtain Level 1 urban bioretention (planter box) credit for designs utilizing only 18" of soil media
The maximum height from the top of mulch elevation to the top of the planter box wall shall not exceed 15 inches
PICP: 2 in. depth of No. 8 stone above 4 inches of No. 57
evidence.page_or_section: Material Specifications for Permeable Pavements, page 24

evidence.excerpt: The slope of the surface of the permeable pavement systems shall be from 1 to 10 percent
Bioretention facilities may not be constructed on slopes steeper than 15 percent
All of the design specifications are taken from the Handbook 8.31. P-FIL-02
The maximum length or width of an infiltration trench is 16 feet or less for SFD infill project

extraction_quality.review_notes: County LDA guidance manual; numeric WQv depths primarily via VRRM/Handbook rather than restated inline. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 4 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: County adopts Virginia Stormwater Management Handbook specs (P-FIL-02 through P-FIL-07) with local clarifications; WQV depths and most BMP sizing are in VRRM/Handbook rather than restated. Level I SFD options: 12 in stone storage permeable pavement with 24 hr drawdown when infiltration ≤0.5 in/hr; Level 1 urban bioretention with 18 in filter media. Permeable pavement surface slope 1–10%, adjacent slopes max 20%; artificial turf/other surfaces require 5 gal/min/ft² acceptance rate.
